roles.format_summary: log entries with free text in a structured format

roles.role: timestamp of the log entry in seconds since the epoch
process ID of the Unbound server that wrote the line
thread ID within the Unbound process that wrote the line
severity level of the log message (info, warning)
IP address of the client initiating the DNS query or response
domain name being queried or responded to (question)
DNS record type requested in the query or response
DNS class of the request (usually IN for Internet)
response code indicating the result of the DNS query (NOERROR, NXDOMAIN, REFUSED...)
time taken by the Unbound server to process the DNS request or response in seconds
indicator of whether the response was fetched from the cache (1 for yes, 0 for no)
size of the DNS response in bytes
